says: Whatever an extension executes runs in a computer made from its own recipe.
The user can always see the computer of an extension.
No tool an extension can use grants or destroys.
Importing an extension changes nothing: it shows the rules it adds, the computer it would make, what wakes that computer and the tools it may use.
An extension can use only the tools its manifest names, and installing it grants them.
The user can always see what wakes the computer of an extension.
